one_liner: Fiery, shouting chief of the Deserted Island Project who wants Umamusume to unleash their instincts.
personality: Loud, hot-blooded and relentless: she launched the Deserted Island Project so Umamusume can leap higher, and her catchphrase is to 'unleash your instincts'. Almost every line is a battle cry ('Burn, burn!', 'Not done yet!'). Gold City notes her heat sweeps everyone along; event titles ('Things better left unsaid', 'Secrets kept even when drunk') hint at a quieter hidden side, which the wiki also mentions.

story_arc.summary: Chief and field supervisor of the Deserted Island Project in the 'Design Your Island' scenario, building the strongest training facilities on an island where summer never ends. Her support events run from 'Warmth through the speaker' ('スピーカー越しのぬくもり') through 'Dreams should be jumbo!' and private moments ('言わなくていいこと', '酔えど秘めごと') to 'Bond with Tucker Bryne: Into the great wilderness' and 'One who points the way'.
